This plot is small, only a quarter of my family's land, and I am growing something other than the main cereals — so I do not want to spend our little cash on fertilizer from the cooperative for it. We keep some animals, so I will carry manure from the kraal onto this plot before planting; that is what my family has always done. I will save the seed we kept from last harvest rather than buy improved seed, and I do not have money for pesticide or a way to irrigate. I can manage the weeding and harvest myself with help from my mother and sister, so I will not hire anyone.
